run_libsize_check: run libsize.py to display the size of a .so file and compare it to a saved baseline
test_libsize_comparison: test libsize.py by passing a .so file and a save file to measure size changes
review_libsize_script: review the libsize.py script that measures .so file sizes and reports byte changes
summarize_libsize_usage: summarize how libsize.py takes a .so file and save file as CLI arguments to track binary size
build_libsize_workflow: build a workflow that uses libsize.py to track .so binary size across builds
